answer: Attention Plume locks digital identities to real-world attentional bandwidth using a summit-style commitment. Each registered agent must publicly log verifiable daily interactions with their identity—reading messages, responding to queries, or engaging in scheduled check-ins—while the raven protocol rejects identities that miss three consecutive sessions. The concrete cost for attackers is sustained real-time monitoring and resource allocation across fake personas; failing to maintain visible engagement for three days permanently forfeits their claimed reputation and access rights.
